finding.text: The new test is unindexed: `Servex/agents/map.md:55` lists every `*.test.mjs` in the folder (`item-read.test.mjs`, `item_tool.test.mjs`, …), but not `item-verbs.test.mjs`. Add it there (Law 10). `Servex/doc/item-tool.md` already names it.

The task log is stale, so a fresh agent would be misled. `item-verbs/session.jsonl` ends with "Landed … (11 checks) … Commit 1e93b29d4", but the branch `worktree/item-verbs` also has a later commit, 500732cc3 (session 7caa4528: dotted `set` keys are checked at their last step). That commit has no log line, and the test now runs 12 checks. Add a log line naming 500732cc3, and make clear the merge must take both commits.

The brief named the test file `Servex/agents/item_tool.test.mjs`, but that file already exists (148 checks), so the work went into a new `item-verbs.test.mjs`. That is the right call, but neither the task log nor the commit says so.

Schema copies: there is only one. The `local` MCP (`item-local.test.mjs`) and RemoteMCP (`RemoteMCP.test.mjs:20`) both register `page_tools()`, so the new params reach every door. `git grep ITEM_DESCRIPTION` finds only `page_tools.js`. The minion's report should have said this explicitly instead of leaving it to the reader.

`ITEM_DESCRIPTION` (`page_tools.js:467`) still opens with "`item({path, delta})`" and only then says "Prefer the verbs". To match the brief's "one sentence at the front", lead with `item({path, get|set|call})`.

The `args` param (`page_tools.js` schema, `args:`) has no `type`. That is valid JSON Schema (any value), but it is the only untyped property among the tool's parameters. Worth a look if a client validator complains.

The `call` query refusal reads `owner?.queries` from the constructor of the node the path reaches. For a List (e.g. `call: "tasks.summary"`), that is List's own `queries` (probably none), so a list-level query would fall through to the "not a method" refusal. Nothing is written either way, but the refusal names the wrong fix.
